description.value: Broyé Cafe & Bakery is a Vietnamese-inspired coffee shop and bakery on Fraser Street in Vancouver, specializing in bold Vietnamese coffee made from premium imported beans using traditional methods alongside creative house-exclusive drinks. The menu also spans fresh pastries, desserts, and Banh Mi sandwiches. It is part of a small growing chain with a second Vancouver location on Hornby Street and a Saskatchewan outpost.
